subject: Invoice submission options — onboarding details
messages:
From: Bridgework Billing <billing@bridgework.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice submission options — onboarding details

Hi Naomi,

We’re kicking off vendor onboarding for Bridgework Systems and I had a couple quick questions about your invoice intake:

- Do you require invoices to be uploaded to the Redwood Vendor Portal, or can we submit via email for the first few months?
- If email is acceptable as a fallback, is there a subject/filename convention you prefer and a CSV/PDF template you want us to follow?
- Are multiple PO numbers allowed on one invoice (we often consolidate vendor invoices across 2–3 POs)?

I’ve attached a recent sample invoice so you can see our typical layout (sample_invoice_bridgework_0001.pdf).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that’s easier.

Best,
Sofia Mendez
Finance Operations
Bridgework Systems
ops@bridgework.com
Attachment: sample_invoice_bridgework_0001.pdf (PDF, 82KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Bridgework Billing <billing@bridgework.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options — onboarding details

Hi Sofia — thanks for the sample and the questions. Welcome aboard. Short answers up front: portal preferred, email allowed as a temporary fallback with strict conventions. Details below so your engineers can bake it into the connector.

Portal (preferred):
- Please use our Vendor Portal for steady-state submissions: https://redwood.app/vendor-onboarding/form/BR-4491
- Portal gives faster ACKs, automated PO matching, and better line-level reconciliation.

Email fallback (allowed for onboarding):
- We can accept invoice PDFs + optional CSV line item payloads to invoices@redwood-invoice-ingest.com for the first 60 days while you complete portal integration.
- Subject convention: Redwood PO(s): <comma-separated PO#s> | VendorName | Invoice# (e.g., Redwood PO(s): PO-1234,PO-2345 | Bridgework | INV-2026-001)
- Filename: vendorname_invoice_invoice#_YYYYMMDD.pdf (lowercase, underscores).
- Single PDF per invoice preferred; if you include a CSV for line items, attach it with the same base filename.

Required metadata / CSV schema for email submissions (column headers expected):
- invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, currency, vendor_tax_id, redwood_entity_code, po_number, line_number, sku_or_description, quantity, unit_price, line_tax, line_total

Line–PO rules:
- You may include multiple PO numbers on one invoice; each line must reference the PO it belongs to (po_number field).
- If a single line applies to multiple POs, split into separate lines with the same description and apportioned amounts.

Attachment limits / acceptance criteria:
- Max PDF size: 10MB.
- We require at least one matching PO number to process automatically; otherwise it enters exception queue.
- Invoices without matching PO will be held and a ticket opened with your billing contact.

Next steps:
1) Please submit the vendor onboarding form (link above) and attach the sample_invoice_bridgework_0001.pdf so we can create your vendor record.
2) If you want the temporary email gateway enabled, confirm and we’ll set it for 60 days.
3) Send a single test invoice to invoices-staging@redwood-invoice-ingest.com with "TEST" in the subject so we can validate parsing.

I’ve copied Jordan (billing ops) and Monica (vendor enablement) to help with the test and portal access.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0128
Related link: https://sales.redwood.com/hubspot/contacts/BR-4491

From: Bridgework Billing <billing@bridgework.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Mendez <sofia.m@bridgework.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 12:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options — onboarding details

On Fri, Jul 31, 2026 at 11:02 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sofia — thanks for the sample and the questions. Welcome aboard. Short answers up front: portal preferred, email allowed as a temporary fallback with strict conventions. Details below so your engineers can bake it into the connector.

Thanks Naomi — that’s very clear and helpful. A couple follow-ups from our integration team after reviewing your CSV schema:

- We’ll split lines by PO number as you recommend. For consolidated shipments we currently put multiple PO numbers in the invoice header rather than per-line; we’ll change to per-line PO fields.
- For the line_tax field, is a tax rate (%) acceptable or do you need the absolute tax per line? We can easily provide either.
- If the invoice references legacy internal Redwood codes instead of the PO (e.g., entity_code vs. po_number), can we include both columns and/or an additional metadata column called redwood_entity_code?

I attached a tiny example CSV to show how we plan to map lines (bridgework_sample_lines.csv). Also confirming — we’ll submit the onboarding form today and request the 60-day email fallback.

Would you prefer we schedule a 20‑minute screen share to run one test invoice through staging?

Best,
Sofia Mendez
Finance Operations
Bridgework Systems
Attachment: bridgework_sample_lines.csv (CSV, 3KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Bridgework Billing <billing@bridgework.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options — onboarding details

Hi Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the sample CSV. Quick operational notes from Billing Ops so we can move you to production quickly: 

- We’ll enable the email fallback gateway to invoices@redwood-invoice-ingest.com for 90 days (we typically do 60, happy to extend to 90 for larger integrations).
- Idempotency: please include an invoice_uuid field when available; if not, invoice_number + vendor_tax_id will be used to dedupe.
- Tax field: absolute tax per line (line_tax in currency) is preferred; we can calculate if you send rate but absolute is more robust for multi-jurisdiction shipments.
- File naming check: please include the invoice date in YYYYMMDD to avoid collisions.

Acceptance checklist for the test invoice to invoices-staging@redwood-invoice-ingest.com:
- Subject: TEST | Redwood PO(s): PO-1234 | Bridgework | INV-2026-TEST
- Attach PDF and optional CSV with the same base filename
- Ensure at least one line references a valid PO or redwood_entity_code

I’ve attached our short onboarding checklist to make sure nothing is missed (onboarding_checklist.pdf). Once the test passes, we’ll flip the vendor record to production and confirm the invoice routing.

If you want to do a 20-minute screen share this week I can be available Wed/Fri in the afternoon PST — drop times that work and we’ll lock it.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Attachment: onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF, 46KB)
